strings.challenge.trial_blades_only.desc: As the Duelist, defeat the Elder Treant using only bladed frames: swords, daggers, greatswords and scythes.
strings.challenge.trial_blades_only.name: Trial of Blades
strings.challenge.trial_cramped_quarters.desc: As the Artificer, defeat the Rime Countess on a forge board shrunk by 2 columns and 1 row.
strings.challenge.trial_cramped_quarters.name: Trial of Cramped Quarters
strings.challenge.trial_first_forge.desc: As the Ironhand Blacksmith, defeat the Molten Foreman with a fixed kit: a longsword, an Ember Core, a Blast Head and a Whetstone.
strings.challenge.trial_first_forge.name: Trial of the First Forge
strings.challenge.trial_ironclad.desc: As the Warden, defeat the Clockwork Colossus while enemies have 20% more HP, using armor-breaking heavy gear.
strings.challenge.trial_ironclad.name: Trial of Iron
strings.challenge.trial_no_sustain.desc: As the Hexblade, defeat the Bone Colossus with all healing and life leech disabled.
strings.challenge.trial_no_sustain.name: Trial Without Mercy
strings.challenge.trial_relay_engine.desc: As the Runecrafter, defeat the Storm Paragon by wiring three weapons together with echo, splitter, amplifier and capacitor pieces.
strings.challenge.trial_relay_engine.name: Trial of the Relay Engine
strings.challenge.trial_status_alchemy.desc: As the Alchemist, defeat the Frost Sovereign using a kit built around Burn, Poison and spreading ailments.
strings.challenge.trial_status_alchemy.name: Trial of Alchemy
strings.challenge.trial_summoner_host.desc: As the Summoner, defeat the Lich Regent with a tome, spectral familiars and summoning runes.
strings.challenge.trial_summoner_host.name: Trial of the Spectral Host

strings.event.abandoned_camp.body: A cold campfire and scattered supplies.
strings.event.abandoned_camp.title: Abandoned Camp
strings.event.ancient_forge.body: A forge older than kingdoms still burns with blue fire.
strings.event.ancient_forge.opt1: Draw essence from the flames (+1 Essence).
strings.event.ancient_forge.title: Ancient Forge
strings.event.arcane_library.body: Shelves of spellbooks hover in the air.
strings.event.arcane_library.title: Arcane Library
strings.event.bandit_toll.body: Forge bandits block the road and demand payment.
strings.event.bandit_toll.opt2: Sneak around (60%: free; else lose 15% HP).
strings.event.bandit_toll.title: Bandit Toll
strings.event.blood_altar.body: An altar asks for blood in exchange for strength.
strings.event.blood_altar.title: Blood Altar
strings.event.bone_merchant.body: A skeletal merchant offers discounts — for a price.
strings.event.bone_merchant.opt1: Buy a relic (50 gold: random rare relay/support).
strings.event.bone_merchant.title: The Bone Merchant
strings.event.broken_golem.body: A broken golem's core still glows.
strings.event.broken_golem.title: Broken Golem
strings.event.clockwork_vault.body: A vault ticks. Its lock resets every few seconds.
strings.event.clockwork_vault.title: Clockwork Vault
strings.event.crystal_cavern.body: Crystals hum in resonance with your relays.
strings.event.crystal_cavern.title: Crystal Cavern
strings.event.cursed_anvil.body: An anvil hums with dark power. Striking it could forge something great — or something wrong.
strings.event.cursed_anvil.opt0: Strike it (gain 2 Essence, gain a curse).
strings.event.cursed_anvil.opt1: Pry loose the rune inlay (random rare rune).
strings.event.cursed_anvil.title: The Cursed Anvil
strings.event.duelist_challenge.body: A masked duelist challenges you to single combat.
strings.event.duelist_challenge.opt0: Accept (elite fight, then a blessing choice).
strings.event.duelist_challenge.title: A Duelist's Challenge
strings.event.eclipse_omen.body: The sun darkens; light and shadow trade places.
strings.event.eclipse_omen.title: Eclipse Omen
strings.event.ember_spring.body: Molten water bubbles from the ground, warm and restorative.
strings.event.ember_spring.opt1: Quench a core in it (random fire-aspected core item).
strings.event.ember_spring.title: Ember Spring
strings.event.forge_spirit.body: A spirit of the forge offers to widen your workbench.
strings.event.forge_spirit.title: Forge Spirit
strings.event.fortune_teller.body: She reads the path ahead in molten glass.
strings.event.fortune_teller.title: Fortune Teller
strings.event.frozen_courier.body: A courier lies frozen, satchel still clutched.
strings.event.frozen_courier.title: Frozen Courier
strings.event.gale_crossing.body: A rope bridge sways in a howling gale.
strings.event.gale_crossing.opt0: Cross quickly (70%: wind core; else 15% damage).
strings.event.gale_crossing.title: Gale Crossing
strings.event.gambler.body: A grinning gambler shuffles cards: double or nothing.
strings.event.gambler.opt1: Bet your blood (50%: 2 Essence; else 20% damage).
strings.event.gambler.title: The Gambler
strings.event.ghostly_smith.body: A ghost hammers at an anvil that isn't there.
strings.event.ghostly_smith.opt0: Help finish its work (+1 Essence, temper a weapon).
strings.event.ghostly_smith.title: Ghostly Smith
strings.event.healing_grove.body: Soft light filters through ancient leaves.
strings.event.healing_grove.title: Healing Grove
strings.event.hermit_alchemist.body: A hermit brews potions in a hollow tree.
strings.event.hermit_alchemist.opt0: Drink the red draught (+10 max HP).
strings.event.hermit_alchemist.opt1: Drink the black draught (60%: blessing; else curse).
strings.event.hermit_alchemist.title: Hermit Alchemist
strings.event.ice_mirror.body: Your reflection in the ice holds a different weapon.
strings.event.ice_mirror.title: The Ice Mirror
strings.event.lost_apprentice.body: A young apprentice asks to be escorted home.
strings.event.lost_apprentice.opt1: Take their toolkit (random support piece, curse).
strings.event.lost_apprentice.title: Lost Apprentice
strings.event.mercenary_offer.body: A mercenary offers to share battle tricks.
strings.event.mercenary_offer.title: Mercenary Offer
strings.event.merchant_caravan.body: A caravan seeks guards for the road ahead.
strings.event.merchant_caravan.title: Merchant Caravan
strings.event.mysterious_crate.body: A sealed crate marked with a forgemaster's sigil.
strings.event.mysterious_crate.title: Mysterious Crate
strings.event.overgrown_shrine.body: Vines cradle a shrine to a forgotten harvest god.
strings.event.overgrown_shrine.title: Overgrown Shrine
strings.event.purifying_flame.body: A white flame burns away corruption — and some flesh.
strings.event.purifying_flame.title: Purifying Flame
strings.event.restless_dead.body: Spirits beg you to lay their bones to rest.
strings.event.restless_dead.opt1: Plunder the tomb (+60 gold, crypt elite fight).
strings.event.restless_dead.title: Restless Dead
strings.event.rune_scholar.body: A scholar studies your weapons with great interest.
strings.event.rune_scholar.title: Rune Scholar
strings.event.sacrificial_forge.body: Feed it an item; it returns something stranger.
strings.event.sacrificial_forge.opt0: Sacrifice an item (lose random item, gain random rare modifier).
strings.event.sacrificial_forge.title: Sacrificial Forge
strings.event.shrine_of_steel.body: Blades of fallen warriors ring softly in the wind.
strings.event.shrine_of_steel.opt1: Take a blade (random blade modifier: serrated).
strings.event.shrine_of_steel.title: Shrine of Steel
strings.event.smugglers_den.body: Smugglers sell contraband relays, no questions asked.
strings.event.smugglers_den.opt0: Buy contraband (40 gold: random rare piece).
strings.event.smugglers_den.title: Smuggler's Den
strings.event.spore_cloud.body: A drifting cloud of spores glows faintly green.
strings.event.spore_cloud.opt0: Breathe deep (+8 max HP, lose 10% HP).
strings.event.spore_cloud.title: Spore Cloud
strings.event.starfall_crater.body: A fallen star still radiates warmth.
strings.event.starfall_crater.title: Starfall Crater
strings.event.storm_conduit.body: Lightning arcs between two pylons, pulsing with stored power.
strings.event.storm_conduit.title: Storm Conduit
strings.event.tinkers_gift.body: A tinker trades gadgets for interesting stories.
strings.event.tinkers_gift.opt1: Tell of your defeats (amplifier relay, 10% damage).
strings.event.tinkers_gift.title: Tinker's Gift
strings.event.training_dummy.body: Battered dummies stand in neat rows.
strings.event.training_dummy.title: Old Training Yard
strings.event.traveling_bazaar.body: Merchants set up stalls; bargains abound for the patient.
strings.event.traveling_bazaar.opt1: Sell spare parts (lose a random item, +55 gold).
strings.event.traveling_bazaar.title: Traveling Bazaar
strings.event.void_rift.title: Void Rift
strings.event.wandering_smith.body: A smith with a cart of tools offers to work your steel for coin.
strings.event.wandering_smith.title: The Wandering Smith
strings.event.weapon_rack.body: Racks of weapons, most rusted beyond use.
strings.event.weapon_rack.title: Abandoned Armory
strings.event.well_of_echoes.body: Your voice returns twice as loud.
strings.event.well_of_echoes.title: Well of Echoes
strings.event.whispering_blade.body: A blade embedded in stone whispers promises.
strings.event.whispering_blade.opt0: Pull it free (random rare modifier, 15% damage).
strings.event.whispering_blade.title: Whispering Blade
strings.forgemaster.alchemist.desc: A status specialist: stronger, longer-lasting Burn and Poison, and kills spread ailments to nearby enemies.
strings.forgemaster.alchemist.name: Alchemist
strings.forgemaster.artificer.desc: A layout tinkerer: a wider forge board, stronger support pieces, and Haste at the start of every wave.
strings.forgemaster.artificer.name: Artificer
strings.forgemaster.blacksmith.desc: A sturdy heavy-weapon specialist: bonus damage with heavy weapons, extra Max HP, and a shield at the start of every battle.
strings.forgemaster.blacksmith.name: Ironhand Blacksmith
strings.forgemaster.duelist.desc: A precision striker: higher crit chance and crit damage, weapons ready from the first moment, and a counterattack when hit.
strings.forgemaster.duelist.name: Duelist
strings.forgemaster.hexblade.desc: A risky fighter who thrives near death: more damage below half HP, life leech, extra gold, and healing on kills.
strings.forgemaster.hexblade.name: Hexblade
strings.forgemaster.runecrafter.desc: A board-circuit builder: higher relay capacity and proc damage, and every 4th hit arcs lightning to nearby enemies.
strings.forgemaster.runecrafter.name: Runecrafter
strings.forgemaster.summoner.desc: A commander of spectral allies: stronger familiars, and one joins the fight at the start of every battle.
strings.forgemaster.summoner.name: Summoner
strings.forgemaster.warden.desc: An unbreakable defender: a starting shield, stronger healing, thorns, and an emergency shield with Fortify at low HP.
strings.forgemaster.warden.name: Warden

strings.legendary.aegis_eternal.lore: It hums a steady hymn of protection, and when its wall is complete, the hymn turns to healing.
strings.legendary.aegis_eternal.name: Aegis Eternal
strings.legendary.bastion_of_dawn.lore: When its bearer falls, the dawn rises in their place, once.
strings.legendary.bastion_of_dawn.name: Bastion of Dawn
strings.legendary.bloodmoon_scythe.lore: It drinks from its wielder before every swing, and repays the debt twice over in the enemy's blood.
strings.legendary.bloodmoon_scythe.name: Bloodmoon Scythe
strings.legendary.colossus_hammer.lore: Too heavy to swing quickly and too heavy to stand before; enemies learn to fly backwards.
strings.legendary.colossus_hammer.name: Colossus Hammer
strings.legendary.cursed_heartforge.lore: Its forge-heart beats only when fed, and it is always hungry.
strings.legendary.cursed_heartforge.name: Cursed Heartforge
strings.legendary.cyclone_glaive.lore: Each sweep sends a wall of wind rolling across the battlefield.
strings.legendary.cyclone_glaive.name: Cyclone Glaive
strings.legendary.dragonbreath_staff.lore: Every other incantation escapes as a roar of fire that scorches all around its target.
strings.legendary.dragonbreath_staff.name: Dragonbreath Staff
strings.legendary.earthshaker_bulwark.lore: Brought down three times, it makes the ground stagger along with the enemy.
strings.legendary.earthshaker_bulwark.name: Groundquake Bulwark
strings.legendary.echoing_greatsword.lore: Its ring carries across the whole field, and the far end of the line hears it as a second blow.
strings.legendary.echoing_greatsword.name: Echoing Greatsword
strings.legendary.eclipse_staff.lore: Sun and shadow take turns in its crystal; what one marks, the other punishes.
strings.legendary.eclipse_staff.name: Eclipse Staff
strings.legendary.frostbound_crossbow.lore: Its bolts are icicles that never melt and never stop, crackling as they tear through every rank.
strings.legendary.frostbound_crossbow.name: Frostbound Crossbow
strings.legendary.frostfang_daggers.lore: Every third bite numbs to the bone, and a body chilled enough cracks like river ice.
strings.legendary.frostfang_daggers.name: Frostfang Daggers
strings.legendary.gearwork_crossbow.lore: A tinkerer's masterpiece that sheds spare cogs with every shot, each one sharpened to a point.
strings.legendary.gearwork_crossbow.name: Gearwork Crossbow
strings.legendary.glacier_bulwark.lore: Strike its bearer and the cold strikes back; blows that land on its face return as a freezing gust.
strings.legendary.glacier_bulwark.name: Glacier Bulwark
strings.legendary.grimoire_of_legions.lore: Each page holds a soldier's name, and every few heartbeats another one steps out to fight.
strings.legendary.grimoire_of_legions.name: Grimoire of Legions
strings.legendary.hellfire_whip.lore: Its flames are hungry and impatient: when one victim falls, they leap to the next.
strings.legendary.hellfire_whip.name: Hellfire Whip
strings.legendary.infernal_sovereign.lore: Forged in a collapsing furnace, it cannot be swung without the ground itself rolling forward in a wave of flame.
strings.legendary.infernal_sovereign.name: Infernal Sovereign
strings.legendary.lifebloom_staff.lore: Flowers open along its length when life ends nearby, mending its wielder, while its steady pulse weaves a shield of petals.
strings.legendary.lifebloom_staff.name: Lifebloom Staff
strings.legendary.mirror_blade.lore: Its polished twin lives in the reflection, striking whoever stands farthest away.
strings.legendary.mirror_blade.name: Mirror Blade
strings.legendary.obsidian_greatsword.lore: Carved from glass born in a dying star, it slowly drags the world toward its edge.
strings.legendary.obsidian_greatsword.name: Obsidian Greatsword
strings.legendary.orrery_of_the_void.lore: A clockwork model of a sky with no stars; at regular intervals, its center collapses.
strings.legendary.orrery_of_the_void.name: Orrery of the Void
strings.legendary.phoenix_greatblade.lore: Its wielder may fall once. Only once. And the blade makes sure the enemy regrets it.
strings.legendary.phoenix_greatblade.name: Phoenix Greatblade
strings.legendary.plague_tome.lore: Its pages never dry; whatever its sickness touches stays sick, and passes it on when it falls.
strings.legendary.plague_tome.name: Plague Tome
strings.legendary.reaper_of_storms.lore: It harvests lightning like wheat, and the sky keeps sowing more.
strings.legendary.reaper_of_storms.name: Reaper of Storms
strings.legendary.rootbinder_whip.lore: Cut from a living vine that still remembers how to hold on; the tangled can only wait to be punished.
strings.legendary.rootbinder_whip.name: Rootbinder Whip
strings.legendary.runeblade.lore: Etched with circuits instead of prayers, it charges the board faster than any other blade and sparks lightning with every fifth cut.
strings.legendary.runeblade.name: Runeblade
strings.legendary.shadowstep_daggers.lore: Each kill opens a door in the dark, and its wielder is already through it before the body falls.
strings.legendary.shadowstep_daggers.name: Umbral Stride Daggers
strings.legendary.soul_harvester.lore: It grows heavier with every soul it reaps, and when the tenth is gathered, something answers from beyond.
strings.legendary.soul_harvester.name: Soul Harvester
strings.legendary.starcaller_bow.lore: Each perfect shot is a prayer, and the night sky answers with falling light.
strings.legendary.starcaller_bow.name: Starcaller Bow
strings.legendary.storm_spear.lore: Thrust skyward, it tore open a thundercloud that now follows its wielder everywhere.
strings.legendary.storm_spear.name: Storm Spear
strings.legendary.stormpiercer.lore: Its arrows were fletched with captured lightning; nothing they strike is solid enough to stop them.
strings.legendary.stormpiercer.name: Stormpiercer
strings.legendary.sunforged_blade.lore: Quenched at noon on the highest peak; when it finds a weak point, the sky drops a star to finish the work.
strings.legendary.sunforged_blade.name: Sunforged Blade
strings.legendary.tempest_repeater.lore: Its gears spin faster with every bolt until the whole frame glows red and must stop to breathe.
strings.legendary.tempest_repeater.name: Tempest Repeater
strings.legendary.thousandfold_edge.lore: Every cut leaves a sliver of steel hanging in the air, waiting for enough of its siblings to become a storm.
strings.legendary.thousandfold_edge.name: Thousandfold Edge
strings.legendary.thunder_maul.lore: Raised once in anger, it called a storm that never learned to leave.
strings.legendary.thunder_maul.name: Thunder Maul
strings.legendary.venomfang_spear.lore: Tipped with a serpent's tooth whose venom never fades, and spreads from every corpse it makes.
strings.legendary.venomfang_spear.name: Venomfang Spear
strings.legendary.venomweaver_lash.lore: Woven from the silk of a spider that never stopped dying; its poison clings forever and leaps to the next victim.
strings.legendary.venomweaver_lash.name: Venomweaver Lash
strings.legendary.voidlance.lore: Its tip is a pinhole into nothing. Every so often, the nothing pulls.
strings.legendary.voidlance.name: Voidlance
strings.legendary.widowmaker_crossbow.lore: It reloads itself in the silence after a kill, already aiming at whoever is next.
strings.legendary.widowmaker_crossbow.name: Gravebolt Crossbow
strings.legendary.windrunner_bow.lore: Its arrows refuse to land, skipping from foe to foe like stones across a pond.
strings.legendary.windrunner_bow.name: Galeskipper Bow
strings.legendary.winters_silence.lore: It breathes frost on everything near, and whatever freezes deeply enough simply breaks apart.
strings.legendary.winters_silence.name: Winter's Silence
strings.legendary.worldbreaker.lore: The first two blows are a warning. The third is answered by the earth.
strings.legendary.worldbreaker.name: Worldbreaker

strings.relay.Amplifier.desc: Amplifier: strengthens every proc that passes through.
strings.relay.Beacon.desc: Beacon: procs passing through Mark their target.
strings.relay.Capacitor.desc: Capacitor: stores charges, then discharges a damaging burst around the target.
strings.relay.Conduit.desc: Conduit: carries signals between its ports unchanged.
strings.relay.Converter.desc: Converter: changes the element of passing procs and adds a status.
strings.relay.Delay.desc: Delay Coil: holds the proc for a moment, then releases it stronger.
strings.relay.Echo.desc: Echo: collects charges from the source weapon; when full, the linked weapon fires an echo attack.
strings.relay.Governor.desc: Governor: needs 1 fewer charge but limits activations per battle.
strings.relay.Prism.desc: Prism: passing procs also apply the source weapon's core status.
strings.relay.Siphon.desc: Siphon: procs routed to a weapon heal you for 10% of their damage; as a dead end it grants a shield instead.
strings.relay.Splitter.desc: Splitter: sends the signal to every connected output, at reduced power.

strings.signature.BladeStorm: Signature: every {0} hits unleash a blade storm that strikes all enemies within 4 units for 90% base damage.
strings.signature.Bloodpact: Signature: while above 30% HP, each attack costs 1.5% max HP and deals double damage.
strings.signature.Colossus: Signature: hits knock non-boss enemies back an extra 0.9 units.
strings.signature.Eclipse: Signature: attacks alternate between Radiant and Shadow; Radiant hits deal +50% to Cursed enemies, Shadow hits +50% to Marked ones.
strings.signature.Gearstorm: Signature: each attack also fires {0} cog projectiles at nearby enemies for 35% base damage each.
strings.signature.InfinitePierce: Signature: projectiles pierce every enemy, and each hit arcs 35% of its damage as Lightning to a nearby enemy.
strings.signature.Mirror: Signature: every attack is mirrored at the farthest enemy in reach as a weaker echo of the previous step.
strings.signature.Overclock: Signature: attack speed ramps +2.5% per attack (up to +150%); after {0} attacks the weapon overheats and stops for 2s.
strings.signature.Phoenix: Signature: once per battle, when you would die, revive with part of your max HP and blast enemies within 3.5 units for 300% base damage.
strings.signature.Plague: Signature: Poison on enemies never expires, and kills spread ailments (half stacks) to enemies within 2.5 units.
strings.signature.QuakeEveryThird: Signature: every 3rd attack triggers a quake around the target, hitting grounded enemies within 2.5 units and stunning non-bosses for 0.8s.
strings.signature.Ricochet: Signature: projectiles keep bouncing to the nearest new enemy, hitting up to 12 different enemies.
strings.signature.Rootbind: Signature: hits Slow enemies for 2s, and Slowed enemies take bonus damage from this weapon.
strings.signature.Sanctuary: Signature: every 2s pulses a shield based on max HP; if your shield already equals half your max HP, heals 3% max HP instead.
strings.signature.ShatterFrozen: Signature: hitting a non-boss with 3+ Chill stacks shatters it for a Frost burst based on its max HP.
strings.signature.Singularity: Signature: periodically opens a gravity well on the densest group, dragging in non-bosses and dealing Arcane damage for 2.5s.
strings.signature.SoulHarvest: Signature: kills grant a Soul (+4% damage each, up to 30); every 10th Soul summons a reaper familiar.
strings.signature.Starfall: Signature: critical hits call down a falling star that strikes the area for Radiant damage a moment later.
strings.signature.StatusSpreadOnKill: Signature: kills spread the victim's ailments (half stacks, except Freeze and Stun) to enemies within 2.5 units.
strings.signature.Thunderhead: Signature: a storm cloud strikes a random enemy at short intervals for 70% base damage and inflicts Shock.
strings.signature.WaveOnAttack: Signature: every attack also launches a ground wave that hits every enemy in its path.
strings.tip.enemy.flying: Flying: melee hits deal 30% less unless the weapon has Reach
